label: SYNTHETIC
note: Recipient matcher golden vectors (A710; REQ-AMB-003, INV-21). Every name is invented. Both the Go matcher (services/core/evidence/recipientmatch) and the Python reference (services/model/tests/test_matcher_vectors.py) load this file, build their matcher from packs/fintech/lexicons/recipient_matcher.json, and must give the same exact fraction (numerator over denominator, in lowest terms) for every case. The expected values were produced by the Python reference matcher (the authority); a Go result that differs is a Go defect. A phonetic case is scored with the voice-path tier enabled (the request has no phonetic member, so the production adapter never enables it). The data file's tiers, folding, nicknames and variants are the matcher's only name knowledge.
